name: urduzaban-source-registry
principle: Keep source datasets separate from canonical UrduZaban data. Import only under compatible rights and with attribution/provenance.

sources.name: Open English WordNet
sources.notes: License is compatible with UrduZaban's CC BY 4.0 data direction when required attribution and WordNet notices are preserved.

sources.name: Kaikki / English Wiktionary — Arabic
sources.notes: Do not blindly merge copyrighted expression into the main CC BY 4.0 Urdu dictionary. Keep source/provenance separated; reviewed factual links may feed Shajra.

sources.name: Kaikki / English Wiktionary — Persian
sources.notes: Keep source data separate and preserve attribution/share-alike obligations for redistributed derived Wiktionary text.

sources.name: Kaikki / English Wiktionary — Urdu
sources.notes: UrduZaban's own canonical Urdu meanings remain independently authored/reviewed.

sources.name: Urdu Wikisource
sources.license: Page/transcription under Wikimedia terms; underlying works require per-work public-domain/rights review
sources.notes: Every work gets author/death-date/source/rights metadata before text ingest.

sources.name: Platts historical Urdu/Hindustani dictionary
sources.license: public-domain historical work; verify edition/source scan
sources.notes: Use as a source/reference; canonical UrduZaban wording remains independently written.
